SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS SQ,
CONCAT('INSERT INTO [EDS].[LOAD_DATES]
( 
	[DESCRIPTION],
	[SCHEMA_NAME],
	[TABLE_NAME],
	[SOURCE_CODE],
	[INSERT_DATE],
	[INSERT_TIME],
	[MIN_LOAD_DATE],
	[MAX_LOAD_DATE]
)

SELECT 
	''',NULL,''' DESCRIPTION,
	''',ST.TABLE_SCHEMA,''' SCHEMA_NAME,
	''',ST.TABLE_NAME,''' TABLE_NAME,
	''',(CASE WHEN UPPER(ST.TABLE_NAME) IN ('BRANCH_DIM','AREA_DIM','REGION_DIM') THEN 'DEP' ELSE LEFT(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(UPPER(ST.TABLE_NAME),'LOANS','LNS'),'LOAN','LNS'),'DEPOSITS','DEP'),'CARDS','CCD'),'CUSTOMER','CRM'),3) END),''' SOURCE_CODE,	
	CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE ''Singapore Standard Time'' AS date) INSERT_DATE,
	CONCAT(FORMAT(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE ''Singapore Standard Time'',''hh''),'':'',''00'') INSERT_TIME,
    MIN(',CASE WHEN TL.COLUMN_NAME='FILE_NAME' THEN 'CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE)' ELSE TL.COLUMN_NAME END,'),
    MAX(',CASE WHEN TL.COLUMN_NAME='FILE_NAME' THEN 'CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE)' ELSE TL.COLUMN_NAME END,')
    FROM ',ST.TABLE_SCHEMA,'.',ST.TABLE_NAME) AS sql_code
FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES ST
INNER JOIN TBL_LIST TL
ON ST.TABLE_NAME=TL.TABLE_NAME
AND ST.TABLE_SCHEMA=TL.TABLE_SCHEMA
;


DECLARE @nbr_statements INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #tbl)
,       @i INT = 1
;

WHILE   @i <= @nbr_statements
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sql_code NVARCHAR(4000) = (SELECT sql_code FROM #tbl WHERE SQ = @i);
    EXEC    sp_executesql @sql_code;
    SET     @i +=1;
END

DROP TABLE #tbl;
